text: Griffon
Nothing beats a Griffon mount to make everyone respect your authoritah.
Pegasus
Imperial pegasi are found in Grey Mountains where Bretonnian and Empire hunters fight over capturing the foals.
Barded Warhorse
Battle Wizards are rarely armoured for it interferes with their casting, yet a steed can and should be barded to add a level of protection.
Duke Alberic's Look-Alike
A jester who is the split image of the Duke of Bordeleaux, highly liked in courts for all sorts of parodies and shenanigans.
The Renegade Crown
This simple circlet is the symbol of unification dreams for the Borderlands, and anybody wearing it would be the leader of the squabbling Princes, or their worst enemy, or just a puppet...
Jewel-Encrusted Sword
This marvellous and shiny weapon is so skillfully done that a trained leader can lead an army to victory in a rainbow of sun glares. It is absolutely worthless in actual combat, though.
Idol of Myrmidia
A delicate statuette of the Goddess, beautiful and useful to show off religious piety. Sometimes it also whispers of tactics in the owner's mind.
Warded List of Secrets

A pain-stakingly compiled registry of awkward and dangerous secrets of the owner's enemies. For good measure, it is said to be enchanted to fly away and replicate should something happen to the possessor...
Shield of Myrmidia
An ancient-looking shield found in the Acropolis of Luccini, capable of blinding foes. Presumably a copy.
Retractable Wristblade
The perfect weapon if you want complex, ineffective, concealed and showy at the same time and if you ask the right customer.
Duellist's Cloak
In Tilea, a cloak could hide a deadly dagger, or it could just show off ermine and velvet. Sometimes it's both.
Conspicuous Hood
Sir, I dare say you should stop intruding in public conversations and pretending to be part of them. No, sir, the white hood doesn't make you look enigmatic or dashing at all. Merely runny.
Heartseeker Spear
A spear said to have been in the possession of holy Sister Fury, hungry for a foe's demise.
Polymath Ugoletti
The engineer responsible for the rework of Da Miragliano's tank design and their maintenance. Technobabble guaranteed, sanity optional.
Kislevite War Bear
Why so surprised? Anybody can get one of these! I just bought it off some Gryphon Legion fellow.
